newsitem.title: FINLAND: IMATRAN VOIMA SAYS IN FIM 400 MLN INDONESIA DEALS.
newsitem.headline: IMATRAN VOIMA SAYS IN FIM 400 MLN INDONESIA DEALS.

text.p: Finnish state-owned power producer Imatran Voima (IVO) said on Thursday it had sealed deals worth over 400 million markka on power plant operating and maintenance services in Indonesia.
"IVO Tuotantopalvelut has won contracts worth over 400 million markka for operation and maintenance of two coal-fired power plants in Indonesia," IVO said in a statement.
The agreement covers operation and servicing of the two plants for 10 years, IVO said.
The plants are under construction, it said.

For the purpose of providing the services IVO has set up a new joint venture, PT TRIVO Power Generation Services PMA, owned 50-50 with power-plant owner PT Transmega Ekacipta Corporation of Indonesia, it said.
